propositions: Backfill close_class only for already-closed bugs where state[close_class] is absent, using structural signals: reverts of STATUS/COMMITS events infer regression, REVIEW_RESULT BLOCK verdicts infer plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR records infer env_integration, otherwise undetermined.
Revert signal requires target_event_type of STATUS or COMMITS; reverts of COMMENT/LINK do not qualify as regression evidence.

Plan-review BLOCK signal is retrieved via all_review_results API and checked for verdict==BLOCK; gate_error_v1 signal requires raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files checking event[data].get(schema)==gate_error_v1.
Backfilled records are written as NDJSON to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, kept separate from authoritative close_class values.
Script is idempotent by ticket_id: skip any bug already in the backfill artifact or whose reduced state[close_class] is set; --dry-run mode prints without writing.

Add !.rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson to .gitignore negation to track the artifact; tests verify exact close_class classification for regression, plan_defect, env_integration, and undetermined cases.
